prompt:
Paint ONE finished frame of a film-like cutscene of our hand-painted point-and-click adventure game 'Posledny zvonec' (Slovakia; eras 1960, 1982, 1995, 2020, 2035). The reference images are numbered in the order they are given: Image 1: place reference: the walled courtyard playground between the Sokolikova panel blocks in Dubravka, Bratislava, in our game (room S69, June 1995): keep its concrete panel walls, the painted panels with the four shapes, the birch, the blue spruce, the globe lamp, the worn asphalt court with the chalk hopscotch and the green bench Image 2: character reference: Zuzana, 40, in June 1995 Image 3: character reference: Kubo, a 7-year-old first-grader of the estate Image 4: prop reference: the brass top cap of a child's bicycle bell

Shot: End of June 1995 in the walled courtyard playground: the summer holidays have begun. A cheerful ring of five children of the housing estate rides round the asphalt court on small bicycles, one behind the other, ringing their handlebar bells; Kubo leads them on his small red bike with stabiliser wheels, ringing his bell loudest, mouth wide open with joy. At the green bench at the edge of the court stands Zuzana, 40, in her navy blouse with the small white round collar and her light beige skirt, a stick of white chalk in her hand, smiling warmly and watching them; the chalk hopscotch on the court behind them. The children are seen from the side and from behind as they curve round the court; nobody looks into the camera.

Characters in this frame (briefs of the approved designs): Zuzana, a 40-year-old Slovak woman standing in the walled courtyard playground of a panel housing estate in Dubravka, Bratislava, on a June afternoon in 1995: calm, kind and quietly funny, with attentive eyes that notice everything. A grown woman with the same soft round face as the girl she was (softer cheeks, a few faint smile lines at the corners of the eyes), gentle, serious, attentive dark brown eyes under straight light-brown eyebrows, a small nose, a small mouth with a slightly full lower lip. Light-brown hair in a simple mid-1990s short cut that ends at the chin, soft and slightly layered, with a side parting and the longer side swept across the top of her forehead. She wears a plain navy-blue short-sleeved cotton blouse with a small round white collar, tucked into a light beige knee-length A-line cotton skirt, and flat brown leather sandals. Her arms hang relaxed; in her near hand, at her side, she holds one short stick of white chalk between her fingers. No jewellery, no rings, no earrings, no watch, no glasses, no bag, no print and no text anywhere. Kubo, a 7-year-old Slovak boy from a panel housing estate in Dubravka, Bratislava, in June 1995, just finishing first grade: lively, quick and proud of what he can do, right now a little offended because the bell on his bike will not ring. He is clearly a real child of seven: small and slight, a soft round child's face with full cheeks, a small nose, bright brown eyes; not a toddler and not a teenager. Short dark-brown hair with a straight fringe. He wears a plain red short-sleeved cotton T-shirt with one broad white band across the chest (no print, no logo), navy-blue cotton shorts, white ankle socks and plain blue canvas trainers without any logo. A small fresh graze on one knee (no plaster). Both arms hang relaxed at his sides, his hands empty.

Light and time: Warm late-afternoon June sun with soft long shadows, the birch leaves glowing; a happy, light mood.

Character references show approved characters of the game on a plain grey card: copy each person's face, age, hair, body proportions, clothes and colours exactly, but pose and light them for this scene; never copy the grey card, the sheet layout or a duplicate of the same person. Place references show the real location and its painted version in our game: keep its architecture, materials and era. Photos are only references: repaint everything in our style, paint any real people in them out, and do not copy brand logos or shop names. Composition: a calm 16:9 picture like a still from the last minutes of a film, with a clear focal point and depth; it is shown whole with a caption below it, so keep the subject well inside the frame. One single image: no panels, no split screen, no border, no frame, no captions, no subtitles, no speech bubbles, no watermark, no UI, unless the shot asks for it. No text or lettering anywhere unless the shot quotes it exactly.

Style: classic 1990s hand-painted adventure game background. Rich painterly brushwork, slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions with gently curved lines, warm late-afternoon sunlight, saturated but harmonious colours, soft dappled shadows under the trees.
